title: Accounting Conservation Note
description: Structured justification REQUIRED to clear a high-risk DeFi accounting function (per scripts/defi_accounting_taxonomy.is_high_risk). Makes the Zaros Part 2 failure a permanent rule: a debt/credit/vault/market accounting function is not cleared just because it looks locally safe — the clear must name the conservation invariant it preserves. Attached to a coverage/deep-pass decision as `accounting_conservation_note` and persisted on the disposition entry. Read by scripts/validate_accounting_clears.py.

accounting_domains.description: Domains this function touches (vault, market, engine, credit, debt, assets, liquidity, collateral, rewards, pnl, funding, liquidation, withdrawals, rebalance, oracle_scaled_values, global_totals, user_totals).

value_in.description: What accounting value enters the function (e.g. 'realized debt delta in USD, SD59x18').

value_out.description: What accounting value leaves / is written (e.g. 'vault.marketsRealizedDebtUsd decreased, usdcAvailableForEngine increased').

ledger_side_updated.description: Which side of the ledger this function writes.

matching_ledger_side.description: The counter-value / matching side that must move with it, and where it is updated (this function or a named caller). 'none' is NOT acceptable for a high-risk clear unless justified.

conservation_property.description: The invariant that must hold (e.g. 'Σ per-vault realized debt == market realized debt distributed', 'every usdcAvailableForEngine increment has a matching decrement').

why_conserved.description: Why the code actually preserves that invariant — the concrete reason, verified against the source, not the NatSpec.

stale_state_risk.description: Can state read become stale between read and write (must a recalc run first)? State the finding ('none — recalculateVaultsCreditCapacity runs first', or the risk).

oracle_or_price_dependency.description: Does the value depend on an oracle-scaled price? Is the scale/decimals consistent with consumers? ('none' if no price involved).

signed_unsigned_or_precision_risk.description: Are signed/unsigned (int/uint, int128/uint128, SD59x18/UD60x18) values mixed safely, no truncation/sign-flip, decimals consistent? State the finding.

global_vs_local_consistency.description: Does a per-entity update keep its global total consistent (Σ parts == total)? State why or 'n/a — no global total touched'.

evidence_span.description: file:line range actually read to justify the clear (e.g. 'Vault.sol:369-443').

duplicate_or_existing_finding_check.description: Whether this overlaps an existing finding; name the id, or 'no existing finding covers this'.
